sentences.text:
Counsel for Petitioner :- G.S. Chauhan Counsel for Respondent :- G.A.
Hon'ble Vivek Kumar Birla,J.
Hon'ble Surendra Singh-I,J.
Heard Sri G.S. Chauhan, learned counsel for the petitioner and Sri G.P. Singh, learned A.G.A. for the State.

The present writ petition has been preferred with the prayer to quash the impugned first information report dated 23.06.2022 registered as Case Crime No. 639 of 2022 under Sections 420,
467, 468, 471 I.P.C., Police Station- Baghpat, District- Baghpat, and for a direction to the respondents not to arrest the petitioner in pursuance of the impugned first information report.

A coordinate Bench of this Court had dismissed Criminal Misc. Writ Petition No. 3933 of 2023,
Avdhesh Shikshak @ Avdhesh Ruhela Vs. State Of U.P. And 3 Others, vide order dated 16.03.2023 which arises out of the same case crime number.

sentences.text:
"Heard learned counsel for the petitioner, learned counsel for the first informant and learned A.G.A. for the State.
The instant writ petition seeks quashing of the FIR dated 23.06.2022 giving rise to Case Crime No. 639 of 2022, under Sections 420, 467, 468, 471 I.P.C., Police Station- Baghpat, District- Baghpat.

Upon hearing learned counsel for the parties and upon a perusal of the record, we find that the submissions made on behalf of the petitioner are his defence, which cannot be looked into while dealing with a writ petition seeking quashing of a first information report.
Moreover, the allegations made in the First Information Report clearly disclose commission of cognizable offences and the allegations are serious in nature.
Therefore, prayer of the petitioner to quash the First Information Report is completely misconceived and is rejected.
The writ petition is, therefore, dismissed, without prejudice to the right of the petitioners to apply for bail/anticipatory bail."
It is not a case of granting any indulgence in this case.
We do not find any good ground to take a different view in the matter.
The writ petition, accordingly, stands dismissed.

Order Date :- 23.3.2023 KS  Smt. Hasina vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 23 March, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/110677473/
